text:
Sam: Quick flag from user testing: on narrow phones the runs table loses the action buttons when sidebar opens. They expect an obvious affordance to access actions. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/compact-issue
Rina: Repro on iPhone SE. Table gets horizontal scroll and small CTA buttons are clipped.
Devon: Two straightforward fixes: (1) add compact card mode under 370px, (2) for condensed table show a small sticky ellipsis column with a menu so actions are always reachable.
Ava: UX note: compact cards should include model name, status pill, and a caret menu. Keep the cost & time secondary. Also change empty state copy to "No runs match filters" with a hint line: "Try clearing filters or expanding the date range."
a11y-bot: Accessibility: ensure menu buttons have aria-expanded and aria-controls, add focus trap when sidebar open, and mark background content aria-hidden. Also ensure color contrast for status pills meets AA.
Rina: For layout, avoid 100vh for height calculations on mobile. Use JS to set a --vh variable from visualViewport height to avoid fold/keyboard jumps.
Devon: I'll open a small PR with compact card CSS, action-menu column, and the --vh change. Will include screenshots and an a11y checklist.
Sam: Thanks all. Tagging design for quick review tomorrow AM.
